waves.name: Nightly chain JOBA to JOBB
waves.rationale: Two jobs whose only coupling is a Control-M condition. Splitting them would put a scheduler condition across a wave boundary, so they move as one deployable unit. Everything in the tree is one nightly cycle.
waves.unblocks: The nightly batch cycle with its ordering proven and a shadow-run harness that any larger tree can reuse. Nothing else in this tree depends on it.
